title: FFT Compound Poisson PMF — Exact NFL Key-Number Pricing
principle_name: FFT Evaluation of Discrete Football Scoring PGFs
evidence_quote: Exact O(N log N) FFT evaluation of G_S(z)=exp(lambda(G_X(z)-1)) (Weber Lect. 13.4 & App. B); key numbers 3,6,7,10,14 priced with zero Gaussian rounding error; PMF sum = 1.00000000, E[S] = 22.845 pts

influence_description: Exact discrete scoring-distribution pricing replacing Gaussian approximation

title: Cramér Large Deviation Tilt — Tail/Milestone Pricing
principle_name: Legendre-Fenchel Rate Function + Exponentially Tilted Measure
evidence_quote: Solves I(a)=sup_theta {theta a - ln M(theta)} and tilted measure p~_i = p_i e^(theta* x_i)/M(theta*) (Weber Lect. 24.1-24.2); theta*=0.2084, I(a)=0.2167, Chernoff_10d=0.11453; 30x-100x variance reduction on rare alt-lines and 2+ TD / 100+ yd milestones
mechanism_quote: Bisection/Newton solve for theta* matching target mean a; tilted PMF reweights tail events; Chernoff bound exp(-n*I(a)) for n drives
how_it_influences_reasoning: Prices tail props (2+ TDs, 100+ yards) and alt spreads via exponentially tilted measure; reduces Monte Carlo tail variance 30x-100x
influence_description: Cramér tilt for rare-event prop and alt-line pricing

title: Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Denoising — SGP Copula Covariance

evidence_quote: Clips noise eigenvalues inside [lambda_-, lambda_+] (Weber Lect. 12.2 & 24.3); clipped 9/12 noise modes on small NFL weekly samples; 6x6 simulated SGP leg correlation matrix denoised (sgp_corr_denoised, diag=[1.0,...])

how_it_influences_reasoning: Removes spurious noise eigenvalues from SGP leg correlation before copula pricing; prevents overconfident parlay legs on small weekly samples
influence_description: Spectral denoiser for 6x6 SGP pairwise correlation matrix
